title: Chroma Items
description: Lightweight mod that makes item names and lore flow with rainbow colors
body:
✨ Features
🌈 Flowing rainbow on item names – each character cycles through colors independently

📝 Rainbow effect on item lore/descriptions as well

🧩 Dropped items display rainbow names on the ground

🎒 Everywhere you look – in inventory, in hand, and in tooltips

⚙️ Highly Configurable
🛠️ Customize the item list via a simple configuration file

🔌 Supports all modded items (format: modid:itemid)

⏱️ Adjustable color flow speed (1–100)

🍎 Default Behavior
By default, the Enchanted Golden Apple has the rainbow effect.
You can freely add or remove any item you want!

All effects are purely visual – they do not affect gameplay and are fully compatible with other mods.

📥 Requirements
Forge 47.4.0 or higher (for Minecraft 1.20.1)

Must be installed on both client and server
